elements.text: 92 live color values and no color tokens. Cyan alone is written 16 ways; white text has 10 opacity steps.

knowledge.text: Only 2 color tokens exist (--background, --foreground: globals.css:4-5), and nothing reads them except @theme. Every UI color is a literal.

Cyan: #00ffff ×8 (NavBar.tsx), #22d3ee/#67e8f9/#a5f3fc in crystal + Cori, Tailwind cyan-200/300/400/500 with 8 alpha steps, rgba(34,211,238,…) ×6 alphas in Card glows, plus the named color "cyan" (Diamond.tsx).
White text at 10 opacities: white, /90, /80, /70, /60, /50, /40, /30, /25, /20. /30 is the most used (×10, mostly GameHUD).
The flip-card back has its own 13-value purple set (Card.tsx:58-60) plus purple-100/400/500 and 4 rgba(168,85,247,…) glows.
Crystal effect defaults: 3 sets of 4 colors (context.tsx:83-85); Cori mood accents reuse 3 of them by hex (CoriBubble.tsx:17-22).
14 more colors live only in dead globals.css classes (lines 35-404, no className uses them).
